description: This file is a TypeScript script that synchronizes knowledge entries from a local JSON file to Devin's Knowledge API, supporting create, update, and optional delete operations.

classes.name: DevinKnowledgeEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a knowledge entry with name, body, and trigger description.

classes.name: DevinKnowledgeOutput
classes.description: Interface representing the structure of the knowledge JSON output containing an array of knowledge entries.

classes.name: ApiKnowledgeEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a knowledge entry as returned by the Devin API, including metadata.

classes.name: ApiListResponse
classes.description: Interface representing the API response for listing knowledge and folders.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the Devin API with proper headers and error handling.

methods.name: listKnowledge
methods.description: Fetches the list of knowledge entries from Devin API.

methods.name: createKnowledge
methods.description: Creates a new knowledge entry in Devin API.

methods.name: updateKnowledge
methods.description: Updates an existing knowledge entry in Devin API.

methods.name: deleteKnowledge
methods.description: Deletes a knowledge entry from Devin API.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the synchronization process, including reading local JSON, fetching remote data, and performing create/update/delete operations based on differences.
